// # Simulation settings

// When a dynamic body is allowed to fall asleep: both velocity magnitudes
// must stay below their thresholds for at least TimeToSleep.
type SleepSettings
    implements IValue
{
    LinearThreshold: Speed;
    AngularThreshold: AngularVelocity;
    TimeToSleep: Duration;
    Enabled: Boolean;
}
